calculation_handling.description: The listed regulations do not apply to prevent the erection or use of a lawfully existing building or structure.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts to know a building is lawfully existing.

calculation_handling.description: For 200.25.1(1), lawful includes existing or authorized on or before July 22, 2022.
The listed parking regulations do not apply to prevent the erection or use of a lawfully existing building or structure.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts to know a building is lawfully existing.

calculation_handling.description: For 200.25.1(3), lawful includes existing or authorized after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025.

200.25.1(1).explanation: A lawfully existing building or structure is not stopped by the listed regulations, including the parking space and accessible parking rules.

200.25.1(2).explanation: For 200.25.1(1), lawful also covers what existed or was authorized on or before July 22, 2022.

200.25.1(3).explanation: A lawfully existing building or structure is also not stopped by the listed parking and accessible parking regulations under the 2025 amendment.

200.25.1(4).explanation: For 200.25.1(3), lawful also covers what existed or was authorized after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025.
